items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: they’re playing like Louis Armstrong, like Lester Young, and they’re respecting the whole tradition.

ctx.x: Good point. Do you like working more in a just piano/vocal or with a bass player or it doesn’t even matter?

If I’m playing with the vocalist for the very first time, piano is safer. The more musicians you add the more chances you take and the bigger gamble it is that you’re going to get something that’s going to clash with somebody else. I welcome the challenge but if I’m by myself the chances of everything going right are just greater just by sheer laughing statistical chance. But it’s fun. Nothing is more fun than a jam session at a club like Mona’s. There’s place in Alphabet City in New York that happens to be on…
Well we were talking about working with other people.
